# README artwork

The root README uses transparent, outlined SVG typography. Light and dark variants are selected with GitHub-supported `picture` elements.

- `wods-readme-header*.svg`: the original four-path WODS mark, its light-blue/white gradient, and a manually spaced wordmark. The mark and letters share a baseline. The light variant adds a fine outline to keep the original pale logo visible on white.
- `wods-free*.svg` and `wods-planned*.svg`: section headings using the same outlined typeface at a fixed reading size.
- `wods-product.png`: an unmodified crop of the live WODS URL-entry interface, captured in English on 8 October 2026. It is a product screenshot, not a mockup. No transcription was submitted.

The typeface is **Barlow SemiBold 1.408**, designed by Jeremy Tribby. All visible SVG text is converted to paths; no font download is required to render the README. The font is licensed under the SIL Open Font License, included in [Barlow-OFL.txt](Barlow-OFL.txt).

Font source: [Google Fonts / Barlow SemiBold](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/barlow/Barlow-SemiBold.ttf). The source font SHA-256 used for the artwork is `86577cb32f8abe3673db53ca0f4221e6856751a4f6730c867e00f720f8bb1fc5`.
